title: Registration of existing stream diversion works.
bodyText: Any person owning or operating a stream diversion works within or outside of a water management area shall register such work with the commission. Registration shall be on the forms provided by the commission. Reporting requirements on the registration forms shall be reasonable.
bodyHtml: [§174C-92]  Registration of existing stream diversion works.  Any person owning or operating a stream diversion works within or outside of a water management area shall register such work with the commission.  Registration shall be on the forms provided by the commission.  Reporting requirements on the registration forms shall be reasonable. [L 1987, c 45, pt of §2]
